name: BCAD workspace
author: kai
description: Shows status of the BCAD multi-repo workspace and provides status, branches, pull, and push actions

barWidget.description: Status, branches, pull, and push across workspace packages

schema.label: VPN mode
schema.description: auto: require the VPN only when a profile named vpnConnection exists on this machine (work machines without it pull/push directly); always: always check and offer to connect; never: skip VPN handling entirely

schema.label: VPN connection
schema.description: NetworkManager connection name used for pull/push; empty disables VPN handling

schema.label: Diff terminal
schema.description: Terminal used for the diff window when clicking a dirty repo in Status: auto picks kitty, foot, alacritty or xterm; or set a terminal command available in PATH

schema.label: Diff window size
schema.description: Floating diff window size as WIDTHxHEIGHT pixels; centered on the current monitor (Hyprland)
